description: A contemporary outdoor patio and garden setting photographed at night. Two square concrete bollard-style pedestals stand in the garden — one in the immediate foreground and one receding toward the background left — each topped with a warm glowing layered source that radiates amber light horizontally between horizontal fins or slats, casting a warm halo onto the concrete pedestal surface below. The ground surface transitions between large flat stone steppers, pea gravel fill, and a small patch of manicured lawn. A raised deck platform of warm-toned horizontal wood decking extends behind, defining a covered patio zone. In the background, a woven rattan hanging egg chair with a white cushion is suspended from an overhead frame, and a sectional outdoor sofa with grey cushions is visible to the right under a covered overhang. The building facade in the far background has simple square multi-pane windows with warm interior light glowing through. Lush dark tree canopy fills the sky at dusk, and various garden plants — ferns, ornamental shrubs — line the edges. The overall mood is serene, modern, and garden-resort in feel. Camera is at low-to-seated eye-level, tilted slightly upward from a position at ground level near the foreground bollard, with a three-quarter view capturing both bollards and the patio behind in depth.
